messages:
kai: dropped a new compact-compare mock into the product file. Key changes: badge legend moved into a collapsible header panel, pin control changed to a pill. link: https://www.figma.com/file/qqqqq/compact-compare-v2
emmie: looks cleaner. one worry: collapsing legend hides context for new users. maybe show a "Legend" chevron with a short summary line like "Latency · Cost · Throughput" so it's discoverable
raj: UX nit: pin pill is better than icon-only. can we add a hover text "Keep this version visible in compare" and make it keyboard focusable with aria-pressed
kai: yes on aria-pressed. also thinking of a small persistent strip that appears when >=1 pinned versions exist. it would show tiny cards that scroll horizontally and link to row. would you prefer overlay or push content down?
emmie: push content down by default for a11y. overlay mode can be an opt-in pref for power users. also it should be reachable via "Skip to pinned versions" link at top for keyboard users
raj: badges: current shorthand (LAT/TP/COS) confused a dev in yesterday's demo. propose full short words on badges (Latency, Cost, QPS) and a two-line tooltip with metric + recent window: e.g., "Latency: 82 ms median \u00b7 p99 240 ms"
kai: good call. microcopy update: change row subtitle from "perf: 82ms" to "82 ms median latency". also use comma separators for throughput like "12,400 qps"
aria-bot: Accessibility check: ensure legend toggle has aria-expanded, pinned strip announces changes via aria-live, badges have accessible names, and chips are keyboard navigable
emmie: filters: in compact mode we show chips inline, but on narrow widths they wrap badly. proposal: collapse into a single summary chip that expands to a popover listing groups. summary chip label: "3 filters active" with a hidden label "Open filter summary" for screen readers
raj: implement undo for clearing filters. small toast with "Undo" link and keyboard shortcut hint. make sure toast is focusable and announced politely
kai: visual tweak: for small badge text use semi-bold + slightly darker bg to hit 3:1 contrast. I'll add token examples to the style doc
emmie: interaction: allow sorting by badge via small chevron menu on badge column header. default sort: median latency. advanced sorts in dropdown (p99, cost per 1k tokens)
raj: dev note: backend exposes median/p99/cost in metadata, so sorting should be straightforward. need to agree on default and UX for tie-breakers
kai: ok action items: emmie's going to make an alternate mock showing pinned strip pushing content and a discoverable mini-legend; raj will draft updated microcopy and keyboard states; i'll add tokens and update component props for pin pill and legend collapse
aria-bot: Added checklist items to thread: legend discoverability, pin strip aria-live, badge name clarity, chip summary popover, undo toast announcement
emmie: i'll post mock links + small screenshots by EOD. thanks :thumbsup:
